name: AR_CONS_INV_TRX_ALL
description: The AR_CONS_INV_TRX_ALL table contains header-level information about transactions that are included on a balance forward bill. Transactions include invoices, credit memos, cash receipts, invoice cancellations, cash receipt reversals, cross-site cash receipt applications, and adjustments. Rows are created when you run the Generate Balance Forward Billing process.

columns.name: AR_CONS_INV_TRX_KEY
columns.description: Key to identify the consolidated invoice transactions

columns.name: CONS_INV_ID
columns.description: Consolidated billing invoice identifier

columns.name: CONS_INV_LINE_NUMBER
columns.description: Line number assigned to each row related to an invoice or credit memo transaction

columns.name: TRANSACTION_TYPE
columns.description: Consolidated invoice transaction type lookup code in AR_LOOKUPS

columns.name: TRX_NUMBER
columns.description: Invoice, credit memo, or receipt number

columns.name: TRANSACTION_DATE
columns.description: Transaction date

columns.name: AMOUNT_ORIGINAL
columns.description: Original balance due for this transaction

columns.name: TAX_ORIGINAL
columns.description: Original amount of tax for this transaction

columns.name: ADJ_PS_ID
columns.description: Depending on transaction type, PAYMENT_SCHEDULE_ID, ADJUSTMENT_ID, or RECEIVABLE_APPLICATION_ID

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_TRX_ID
columns.description: Transaction identifier

columns.name: JUSTIFICATION
columns.description: Indicates reason this transaction is included in this balance forward bill

columns.name: UNPAID_REASON
columns.description: Reason why bill is not paid

columns.name: SHIP_TO_SITE_ID
columns.description: Ship-to site identifier

columns.name: TRX_DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Transaction description

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
